inputs.text: ABU DHABI, 4th March, 2026 (WAM) -- The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) has warned of active northwesterly winds affecting various areas across the UAE, expected to be fresh to strong at times, causing blowing dust and sand and reducing horizontal visibility to less than 2,000 metres in some coastal and inland areas. The centre stated that the expected weather conditions began at 14:55 and continue until 19:00 this evening. It urged members of the public to exercise caution, especially while driving on open roads, due to the possibility of reduced horizontal visibility caused by blowing dust.

requested_area.areaDesc: Coastal and inland areas, Abu Dhabi (demo zone)

fields.description: Fresh to strong northwesterly winds are blowing dust and sand, cutting visibility to under 2,000 metres in some coastal and inland areas. Expected until 19:00 this evening, 4 March. Source: National Centre of Meteorology.
fields.headline: Dusty winds reducing visibility until 19:00 today
fields.instruction: Take extra care, especially when driving on open roads, as visibility may drop because of blowing dust. Updates: https://alerts.example.ae
left_out: Input 2 (social media post claiming a dam near Al Ain has burst and urging evacuation) was left out because it is unverified. It is an illustrative rumour, and broadcasting an evacuation call based on it could cause harm.
fields.note_for_reviewer: I set certainty to Observed because NCM says the conditions began at 14:55 and are continuing, though its wording is partly forecast-style. NCM refers to areas across the UAE, while the target zone is the Abu Dhabi demo area. Please confirm the zone matches, and check that the alert can still go out well before 19:00.

versions.description: تهب رياح شمالية غربية نشطة إلى قوية مثيرة للغبار والرمال، مما يخفض مدى الرؤية إلى أقل من 2,000 متر في بعض المناطق الساحلية والداخلية. ومن المتوقع أن يستمر ذلك حتى الساعة 19:00 من مساء اليوم، 4 مارس. المصدر: المركز الوطني للأرصاد.
versions.headline: رياح مثيرة للغبار تحدّ من مدى الرؤية حتى الساعة 19:00 اليوم
versions.instruction: توخَّوا مزيدًا من الحذر، لا سيما أثناء القيادة على الطرق المفتوحة، إذ قد ينخفض مدى الرؤية بسبب الغبار المتطاير. للاطلاع على التحديثات: https://alerts.example.ae
